svg.title: PI control of the water heater
svg.desc: At the first update P gives 30 percent and the integral 0.75 percent. As the water warms P falls and the integral rises; at 35 degrees Celsius P is zero and the integral holds the heater at 75 percent. After 30 kilowatts more heat loss the integral rises to 90 percent and the water returns to 35 degrees.
svg.text: PI control of the water heater
Simulator run of this project · Kp = 2 %/°C, Ki = 0.5 %/(°C·s) · numbers answer the predictions
Colder inlet water: 30 kW more heat loss
